settings.headline: "Best" depends on the appointment you've booked.
settings.subhead: There isn't one best numbing cream for everyone. There is a right one for your specific procedure. Senseless is built for aesthetic appointments — three strengths, three formats, formulated to match what each kind of session asks of the skin.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless system view — multiple SKUs

settings.headline: "Best" is a comparative claim. We don't make those.
settings.body: Most landing pages ranking for "best numbing cream" claim to be the best. Senseless doesn't. We make claims about what we are — UK-formulated, built for aesthetic procedures, available in three strengths and three formats. We don't make claims about what other brands are or aren't. Different brands, different formulations, different regulatory contexts. The honest answer to "best" is "best for what" — and that's a question Senseless is built to answer.

settings.headline: Three strengths. Three formats. Matched to the appointment.
settings.body: Strength matches the procedure: Clinical for routine, Advanced for longer or more sensitive, Professional for the most demanding. Format matches the treatment area and session length: cream for most face procedures, gel for sustained sessions, spray for body and broader zones. Together they answer two questions — strength and format — which is more useful than answering one ("best") with a single product recommendation that can't actually fit every appointment.

settings.question: What's the best numbing cream for lip fillers?
settings.answer: Clinical Strength Cream is the everyday recommendation. Advanced if your lips are particularly sensitive or your appointment runs longer than a quick top-up. Professional is overkill for lip fillers — save it for the procedures that need it.

settings.question: What's the best numbing cream for microneedling?
settings.answer: Advanced Strength is the default. Cream or gel both work — gel often suits sustained microneedling sessions. Professional for the most intensive full-face appointments.

settings.question: What's the best numbing cream for injections more broadly?
settings.answer: For aesthetic injections (fillers, Botox), Clinical Strength Cream is the everyday default. Advanced for longer sessions or larger treatment areas.

settings.question: Is Senseless better than other brands?
settings.answer: We don't make comparative claims. Senseless is formulated for aesthetic procedures specifically — that's the brand position, not a competitive ranking.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
